title: Global Vendor Manager, Data Center Infrastructure
description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Atlanta, GA; Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Seattle, WA; Washington D.C. About the Role This role focuses on sourcing and managing suppliers globally for Data Center Infrastructure services, including structured cabling, DC infrastructure installation, power system installation, cooling system deployment, cage/space fitout, and critical infrastructure commissioning. You will create sourcing plans for infrastructure categories and deliver these through supplier capability reviews, technical assessments, pre-qualification, onboarding, and master contract negotiations. This position requires deep technical knowledge of data center infrastructure design and build-out—you must understand power and cooling sizing calculations, cold aisle containment design principles, caging requirements, electrical distribution architectures, and the end-to-end process of a full-scale DC space/cage fitout. You will leverage this expertise to drive informed vendor discussions, evaluate technical proposals against Cloudflare's infrastructure standards, and negotiate competitive pricing that reflects true value and risk allocation. You will forge strategic partnerships with infrastructure vendors, evaluate their performance against clearly defined technical and commercial metrics, and balance the priorities of both Cloudflare and your suppliers to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes. This role complements the Global Vendor Manager, Data Center Services (focused on field services, IT asset disposal, logistics, and rack integration) by owning the infrastructure build, installation, and critical systems domain. Key Job Responsibilities Strategic Sourcing & Category Management Develop and execute global sourcing strategies for data center infrastructure categories: structured cabling, power systems (UPS, PDUs, generators, electrical distribution), cooling systems (CRAC, containment, airflow), cage/space fitout, fire suppression, and commissioning services Build and maintain robust supplier portfolios across multiple geographies to support Cloudflare's rapid data center expansion Conduct market research and supplier landscape analysis to identify qualified vendors, benchmark capabilities, and maintain competitive tension Create category-specific sourcing plans that balance cost competitiveness, technical quality, vendor capacity, and risk mitigation Drive supplier diversity and geographic coverage to ensure business continuity and avoid single points of failure Technical Vendor Assessment & Qualification Perform technical capability reviews evaluating vendor certifications (BICSI, PE licenses, manufacturer credentials), workforce qualifications, and past project delivery Assess vendor capacity for power and cooling sizing, load calculations, redundancy design (N+1, 2N), thermal modeling, and containment design Lead technical due diligence including reference site visits, project portfolio reviews, and proof-of-concept evaluations Validate vendor experience with full-scale DC cage/space fitouts from design through commissioning Ensure vendors meet Cloudflare's technical, operational, safety, and compliance standards across all regions Supplier Lifecycle & Contract Management Lead end-to-end supplier onboarding from identification and technical assessment through contract execution Negotiate master service agreements, statements of work, and pricing frameworks that deliver competitive TCO while maintaining quality Structure contracts with clear technical specifications, acceptance criteria, performance guarantees, and remediation terms Manage commercial relationships including pricing reviews, volume commitments, rate card negotiations, and cost optimization Partner with Legal, Procurement, and Finance on contract governance, compliance, and risk management Performance Management & Governance Design and implement supplier performance scorecards measuring project delivery timelines, technical quality (workmanship, code compliance, test pass rates), safety performance, cost adherence, and warranty responsiveness Establish regular business review cadences with strategic suppliers to monitor performance, address gaps, and drive continuous improvement Manage supplier risk assessments including financial health monitoring, capacity planning, and business continuity planning Drive corrective action plans when vendors underperform on technical or commercial commitments Escalate critical performance
